Tincture of fresh plant. Clinical. ─ Calculi. Nightmare. Characteristics. ─ Pariet . belongs to the nettles. It grows on old walls, and its ashes contain much Nitre ( K. nit .). Cooper has used it with success in a case of renal calculus; and in one case it produced nightmare, the patient dreaming of being buried alive in the midst of ruins. Relations. ─ Compare: Urt. urens, Kali nit. Copyright © Médi-T ® 2000 Main
